components.name: Asymmetric rock foot
components.function: Need source-shaped arch footing/curve/crown sections and their hidden contact faces; use shared shoreline rocks, sand and waves. Opal veins/pearls/star pendants exist in image, so add isolated attachment views only where unclear. Salt plants/seabirds/crabs proposed; tide/navigation unverified. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
components.construction: One isolated asymmetric rock foot matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
